title: Women's Dance Mom – Bun Tight, Wallet Empty Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Dance Mom Zip Up Hoodie – Bun Tight, Wallet Empty
seo.description: A dance mom zip up hoodie: BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. WALLET EMPTY. on the back around a dance mom with her bag, plus stitched WALLET EMPTY. on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This dance mom zip up hoodie is for the dance mom who has the bun tight, the smile on and the wallet empty, zipped on for the studio waiting room and the competition weekend.

A dance mom in a pink jacket and striped leg warmers walks with a big dance bag, a coffee and a tote, her hair in a tight bun, in pink, maroon, cream and grey with a worn print texture. BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. runs above her in two lines and WALLET EMPTY. below in two lines of heavy soft serif capitals: pink and cream on Black and Navy, raspberry and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small WALLET over EMPTY. wordmark in the same soft serif capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word ENCORE is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest WALLET EMPTY. wordmark and left-cuff ENCORE, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Bun Tight, Wallet Empty zip hoodie fit?
The Bun Tight, Wallet Empty dance mom zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this dance mom hoodie warm enough for chilly studio lobbies?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles chilly studio lobbies, competition weekends and the drive home with the dance bag well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, BUN TIGHT. SMILE ON. above the dance mom and WALLET EMPTY. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small WALLET over EMPTY. wordmark in the same soft serif capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and ENCORE is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The WALLET EMPTY. wordmark on the chest and the ENCORE cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a dance mom, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the dance mom who has paid for every costume and still smiles. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
